# PRD -- Slice 7: Outbound Dispatch Rail

Sprint: Phase 2 / Workstream Backend
Status: Proposed (2026-07-19)
Ticket handle: PAXOS-S7-DISPATCH
Owner: Platform Engineering
Last updated: 2026-07-19

================================================================================
1. PROBLEM SUMMARY
================================================================================

ClearAuth today can draft an appeal letter and park it at `ready_for_review`,
but the platform has no backend mechanism for transmitting provider-facing
requests -- fax, EHR task creation, or portal submission -- once a reviewer
approves. The `WorkflowPlan` field on `CriterionResult` already encodes the
`action`, `recipient`, `channel`, and `turnaround` a coordinator should
execute, and the queue workspace demo dispatches outbound workflows visually,
but there is no live backend adapter behind it.

Separately, the `awaiting_documentation` CaseStatus represents a pre-submission
documentation gap (e.g., a missing chart note before the PA can be filed), but
no mechanism currently transitions a case into that state via an API action or
writes it durably to the audit trail. Coordinators track this state in their
heads or in side channels.

This means:

- Approved letters sit in `ready_for_review` permanently; no outbound
  transmission happens.
- The `WorkflowPlan.channel` field (fax / EHR-task / portal) carries no
  actionable backend semantics.
- The `awaiting_documentation` lifecycle branch in 05-state-lifecycle.md is
  modeled but never reachable from a real API action.
- Gap G7 / unit O11 in the roadmap (doc 10) is listed as "demo dispatch
  shipped; no backend."

================================================================================
2. GOALS
================================================================================

1. Implement an outbound dispatch adapter (`etl/outbound_dispatch/`) that
   accepts a canonical `DispatchRequest` and routes it to the correct channel
   adapter (fax stub, EHR-task stub, portal stub), following the same adapter
   pattern as `etl/pas_rail/`.

2. Add a `POST /api/cases/{correlation_id}/dispatch` endpoint that drives the
   dispatch adapter and transitions the case to `awaiting_documentation` or
   `submitted` depending on dispatch outcome.

3. Extend the `AuditRecord` with a `dispatch_ref` field tracking what was
   transmitted and on which channel, written before the terminal event per
   ADR-0009.

4. Wire `WorkflowPlan` production into the `tier_router` node so that an
   `exception`-tier run includes the recommended workflow plan for the first
   flagged criterion.

5. Produce a new `DispatchEvent` SSE terminal for the dispatch route.

6. Ensure all three channel stubs (fax / EHR-task / portal) produce a
   deterministic `dispatch_ref` (same idempotency semantics as `submission_ref`
   on the PAS rail).

7. Pass all new code through the standard TDD cycle (RED -> GREEN) with unit +
   integration coverage.

================================================================================
3. NON-GOALS
================================================================================

- Live fax/EHR integration. This slice ships stubs only; real channel adapters
  are per-connector work (roadmap "Payer/EHR connectors").
- Automated submission without human approval. Dispatch is always triggered by
  an explicit API call; the approval gate is never bypassed.
- Round-trip determination polling. The dispatch rail sends; payer response
  arrives via a separate future connector, not this slice.
- UI for dispatch. The queue workspace already has a demo dispatch surface;
  wiring it to the live endpoint is a frontend live-integration task
  (Workstream SU), not in scope here.
- SMTP / SMS channels. Only fax, EHR-task, and portal stubs are in scope.
- Changing the PAS rail. The initial-PA dispatch path (`etl/pas_rail/`) is
  separate and unaffected.

================================================================================
4. REQUIREMENTS
================================================================================

Functional
----------

D-1  POST /api/cases/{correlation_id}/dispatch accepts a DispatchRequest body
     (correlation_id, channel, recipient, payload_ref) and returns a
     DispatchResponse with a dispatch_ref, channel, and timestamp.

D-2  The dispatch endpoint transitions CaseStatus from ready_for_review ->
     awaiting_documentation (if WorkflowPlan.channel triggered an outbound doc
     request) or ready_for_review -> submitted (if no doc gap, direct
     transmission).

D-3  The dispatch adapter (etl/outbound_dispatch/adapter.py) accepts a
     canonical DispatchRequest and produces a DispatchOutcome; the channel is
     selected by a DispatchRouter strategy, never branched on inline.

D-4  Three channel stubs are required: FaxAdapter, EhrTaskAdapter,
     PortalAdapter. Each produces a deterministic dispatch_ref =
     {channel}-{sha256(correlation_id+recipient)[:12]} so a retry never mints
     a second rail identity.

D-5  AuditRecord gains a nullable dispatch_ref: str | None and
     dispatch_channel: str | None; the dispatch endpoint writes a new
     AuditRecord with provenance=dispatched before returning.

D-6  tier_router.py populates PipelineState.workflow_plan with the WorkflowPlan
     from the first needs_review or conflict CriterionResult when
     tier == exception.

D-7  The dispatch endpoint is dual-auth (Bearer or session cookie + CSRF)
     consistent with every other /api/* route and is tenant-scoped: a session
     can only dispatch cases belonging to its tenant_id.

D-8  A dispatch of an already-dispatched correlation_id is idempotent: if an
     AuditRecord with provenance=dispatched and the same correlation_id already
     exists, return the existing dispatch_ref without re-dispatching.

Non-functional
--------------

D-9  Stub adapters complete in < 50 ms (no I/O). Real adapters inherit a 30 s
     timeout + circuit breaker from CircuitBreaker in ml/llm_backend.py (the
     shared primitive).

D-10 PHI in payload_ref is never logged; the audit record carries only the
     dispatch_ref hash, not letter text.

D-11 The endpoint is gated by the same security-hold check as the generation
     pipeline: a held request cannot be dispatched.

================================================================================
5. WORKFLOW MODELING
================================================================================

POST /api/cases/{correlation_id}/dispatch
          |
          v
  auth_middleware (dual-scheme, 401 before body parse)
          |
          v
  TenancyScope.assert_owns(correlation_id)  <- fail-closed, 403 if mismatch
          |
          v
  load AuditRecord for correlation_id
  |-- no record found -> 404
  |-- provenance == dispatched (idempotent) -> 200 existing dispatch_ref
  +-- outcome != done -> 409 (letter not yet finalized)
          |
          v
  DispatchRouter.route(channel) -> ChannelAdapter
          |
  ChannelAdapter.dispatch(DispatchRequest) -> DispatchOutcome
  |-- ok  -> dispatch_ref, channel, timestamp
  +-- err -> ErrorEvent, no audit written for outcome
          |
          v
  AuditRecord(provenance=dispatched, dispatch_ref, dispatch_channel)
  written BEFORE response (ADR-0009 durability rule)
          |
          v
  CaseStatus transition:
  |-- workflow_plan present -> awaiting_documentation
  +-- no workflow_plan      -> submitted
          |
          v
  DispatchResponse { dispatch_ref, channel, status, case_status }

State transition integration (extends 05-state-lifecycle.md):

  ready_for_review
      |  POST /api/cases/{id}/dispatch
      |-- [workflow dispatched] --> awaiting_documentation
      +-- [no doc gap]          --> submitted

================================================================================
6. DATA MODEL CHANGES
================================================================================

New models (backend/models/schemas.py)
--------------------------------------

  class DispatchChannel(str, Enum):
      fax      = "fax"
      ehr_task = "ehr_task"
      portal   = "portal"

  class DispatchRequest(BaseModel):
      model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True)
      correlation_id : str            # <= 200 chars -- parked run handle
      channel        : DispatchChannel
      recipient      : str            # <= 500 chars -- fax number / EHR endpoint / portal URL
      payload_ref    : str            # <= 200 chars -- artifact hash (letter ref or doc ref)
      tenant_id      : str            # stamped from session; not client-supplied

  class DispatchOutcome(BaseModel):
      dispatch_ref   : str            # deterministic channel-scoped ID
      channel        : DispatchChannel
      dispatched_at  : datetime
      status         : Literal["ok", "error"]
      error_message  : str = ""

  class DispatchResponse(BaseModel):
      dispatch_ref   : str
      channel        : DispatchChannel
      case_status    : CaseStatus
      dispatched_at  : datetime

AuditRecord additions
---------------------

  dispatch_ref     : str | None = None
  dispatch_channel : str | None = None
  # provenance gains new value: AuditProvenance.dispatched = "dispatched"

PipelineState addition
----------------------

  workflow_plan : WorkflowPlan | None = None
  # populated by tier_router for exception tier

Parity requirement: DispatchChannel, DispatchRequest, DispatchResponse mirror
into src/types.ts (parity-tested per hard-3); AuditProvenance.dispatched added
to both sides in the same commit.

================================================================================
7. API CHANGES
================================================================================

New endpoint
------------

POST /api/cases/{correlation_id}/dispatch

  Auth    : Dual scheme (Bearer or cookie + CSRF). Tenant-scoped.
  Param   : correlation_id -- the parked/finalized run handle.
  Body    : DispatchRequest (strict Pydantic; tenant_id stamped by middleware).
  200     : DispatchResponse
  404     : case not found or not owned by tenant
  409     : letter not yet finalized (outcome != done)
  200 (idempotent) : pre-existing dispatch_ref returned unchanged

GET /api/audit/records extension
---------------------------------

No route change; AuditRecord gains two nullable fields. Existing consumers see
no breakage (additive change).

OpenAPI / wire-types update
----------------------------

`npm run api:dump` + `npm run api:types` re-run; wire-types-freshness CI job
gates on no diff.

================================================================================
8. LANGGRAPH INTEGRATION
================================================================================

tier_router node update (agents/nodes/tier_router.py)
------------------------------------------------------

  run_tier_router(state: PipelineState) -> PipelineState
    if tier == exception:
        first_flagged = next(
            (cr for cr in state.request.criteria_results
             if cr.status in (CriterionStatus.needs_review, CriterionStatus.conflict)
             and cr.workflow_plan is not None),
            None
        )
        state["workflow_plan"] = first_flagged.workflow_plan if first_flagged else None
    return state

- The node remains pure ((PipelineState) -> PipelineState); no I/O.
- workflow_plan rides DoneEvent as an optional field (additive, no client
  breakage).
- No new graph edges; this is an in-node enrichment.

Graph (agents/graph.py)
------------------------

No topology change. PipelineState gains workflow_plan: WorkflowPlan | None =
None (default None -- does not affect existing runs).

================================================================================
9. NEW MODULE: etl/outbound_dispatch/
================================================================================

  backend/etl/outbound_dispatch/
  |-- __init__.py
  |-- adapter.py          # DispatchRouter + ChannelAdapter Protocol
  |-- fax_adapter.py      # FaxAdapter stub
  |-- ehr_task_adapter.py # EhrTaskAdapter stub
  +-- portal_adapter.py   # PortalAdapter stub

ChannelAdapter Protocol:

  class ChannelAdapter(Protocol):
      def dispatch(self, req: DispatchRequest) -> DispatchOutcome: ...

Deterministic dispatch_ref:

  def _make_dispatch_ref(channel: str, correlation_id: str, recipient: str) -> str:
      raw = f"{correlation_id}:{recipient}"
      return f"{channel}-{hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]}"

Stubs return status="ok" synchronously; real adapters will wrap I/O in the
shared CircuitBreaker.

================================================================================
10. UI SURFACES
================================================================================

UI wiring is out of scope for this backend slice. The queue workspace
(src/components/portfolio/) already renders a dispatch surface driven by
fixture data. When the live dispatch endpoint exists, the Workstream SU
single-shell migration (unit O11 behind the capability manifest
src/capabilities.ts) wires the dispatch button to
POST /api/cases/{id}/dispatch via the typed API client (src/lib/api.ts).

Demo-surface note: the awaiting_documentation -> processing transition (docs
received) is modeled in the state machine but has no backend trigger yet; that
remains a future slice.

================================================================================
11. TEST CASES
================================================================================

Unit (backend/tests/unit/)
---------------------------

Module: test_dispatch_adapter.py
  - FaxAdapter produces deterministic ref
  - retry returns same ref
  - EhrTaskAdapter and PortalAdapter produce distinct channel-prefixed refs
  - DispatchRouter routes by channel
  - unknown channel raises typed error

Module: test_tier_router_node.py (extend)
  - exception-tier run with flagged criterion + workflow_plan populates
    state.workflow_plan
  - exception-tier run with no flagged workflow_plan leaves field None
  - routine/complex runs leave field None

Module: test_audit_dispatch.py
  - AuditRecord with provenance=dispatched serializes/deserializes
  - parity mirror test for AuditProvenance.dispatched

Module: test_dispatch_idempotency.py
  - second dispatch call with same correlation_id returns existing dispatch_ref
    without re-dispatching

Contract
--------

test_schema_parity.py extended: DispatchChannel, AuditProvenance.dispatched
present in both schemas.py and src/types.ts.

Integration (backend/tests/integration/)
-----------------------------------------

Module: test_dispatch_endpoint.py
  - Bearer auth dispatches successfully
  - cookie + CSRF auth dispatches
  - wrong tenant 403
  - not-yet-finalized case 409
  - unknown correlation_id 404
  - idempotent second call 200 same ref
  - audit record written before response
  - case_status transitions correctly

Eval / security
---------------

  test_phi_redact.py extended: dispatch_ref in audit contains no PHI-shaped
  content.
  test_prompt_injection.py: recipient field sanitized (no injection phrases
  accepted).

================================================================================
12. RISKS
================================================================================

Risk: correlation_id not yet in audit store at dispatch call time (race)
  Likelihood: Low | Impact: Medium
  Mitigation: Dispatch endpoint reads audit store with required scope
  (fail-closed); 404 if not found; client retries.

Risk: Real fax/EHR adapters introduce PHI-in-transit risk
  Likelihood: Medium | Impact: High
  Mitigation: Stub-only in this slice; real adapters require a dedicated
  security review + ADR before landing.

Risk: dispatch_ref collision across tenants
  Likelihood: Very Low | Impact: Low
  Mitigation: Deterministic ref includes correlation_id (already tenant-scoped
  via audit boundary).

Risk: CaseStatus transition bypasses approval gate
  Likelihood: Low | Impact: High
  Mitigation: Dispatch endpoint only accepts ready_for_review cases; any other
  status returns 409.

Risk: Parity drift for new AuditProvenance.dispatched
  Likelihood: Low | Impact: Medium
  Mitigation: Parity test added in same commit; wire-types-freshness CI gate
  catches OpenAPI drift.
